name: reel-mesh
description: Record README demo GIFs for web projects from scenario files, with an agent skill that picks what to show and inserts the result.

interface.shortDescription: Record README demo GIFs from scenario files.
interface.longDescription: Pick what to demo, write a scenario, record it step by step in a browser, review the frames, render a GIF, and insert it into the README.
defaultPrompt: $reel-mesh:reel-mesh make a demo GIF for the README
